name: kagu-leads-worker
description: Standalone Google Maps lead-gen crawler. Runs on a VPS or locally — never deployed with the site. Talks to the same Supabase project as the admin panel.

scripts.deploy:mac: rsync -a --delete --exclude worker.log ./ ~/kagu-worker/ && launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.kagu.leads-worker && echo 'worker resynced + restarted'
